# Pending changes (since patch 0014, 2026-11-20)

## 2026-11-20 - Landing never waits for pictures: placeholders on planets too; the HUD gauge on its own

Asked: "when landing still waits to load all assets until it renders the planet surface, i see no use of low res
placeholders like i instructed"; "remove health and shield numbers and labels, also remove the panel around the new
gui, remove also the display of drachmas - drachmas available is displayed in stations and in inventory".
Found: a surface waited for its tile set's pictures before planning (ProcArt.ensure), for every building, scenery and
creature picture (a planet made whole), and raised no building until every tile_ picture was in
(ProcArt.pending(["tile_"])) - its ground atlas, walls, floors and roofs are made from the pictures' pixels, so they
needed the real ones. MinoanTiles.texture/image loaded a picture on the spot when it wasn't in. Measured (desktop, cold,
landing right after a new game): the surface shown 3.6 s in, buildings only after all art.
Done:
- ProcArt.image_now(key): the real Image if in, else a procedural placeholder (PlaceholderArt) at the picture's exact
  size (sizes.json = the imported size: 568 tile pictures checked) - so whatever is packed from it has the same layout
  when the real one comes; the real one asked for first. is_in(key); real_serial counts arrivals.
- TerrainTiles: pieces made from source Images (prefetch: real or placeholder); pieces from placeholders tracked (_ph,
  not saved to the tile cache) with ramps, rims and blocks made from a placeholder ground; atlases packed with them
  remembered; refresh() makes those pieces again on a worker when their pictures are in, gives each texture its new
  image (set_image: the same texture) and packs the atlas again in place; atlas_serial tells surfaces to redraw their
  ground's pictures (GroundChunks.refresh).
- MinoanTiles: image() never waits (placeholder images, is_placeholder, upgrade); texture() hands out ProcArt.sprite
  (its placeholder, swapped in place); walls, floors and roofs: a stub shape at once (a few fills: the wall's face in
  its piece's colour, a darker top course; the floor's diamond), composed on worker threads (pump: 16 at a time) and
  given their image in place; those composed from placeholders composed again when the pieces are in (refresh). (They
  had been composed in the frame - 5-21 ms each, 68 at a landing: a 450 ms frame once buildings stopped waiting.)
- ProcArt drives it: MinoanTiles.pump() each frame; refresh a few times a second while pictures arrive.
- PlanetSurface: no ensure / pending waits (prefetch only: its pictures first).
- Measured (desktop, cold, landing at once after a new game, 79-107 of 1093 pictures in): the surface shown 3.5 s in
  (was 3.6-4.1), worst frame 109 ms (the reveal; was 99-460); the palace's pieces grey placeholder blocks, then real ~6 s
  later.
- HUD: the health gauge without numbers (hover the ring: "Hull 80 / 100  Shields 40 / 100" and what it is) and
  without a panel round it (space: the Status panel's style empty; the drachmas row hidden; fuel stays under the
  gauge); on foot the gauge stands under the planet's panel, whose line is now "Carrying: n / 12 slots".
- Fix: a Minoan axe guard chasing a foe that was freed errored every frame (_alive typed Node2D): Variant now.
- Docs: game.md (the gauge: no numbers, hover; drachmas at stations and in the inventory; on foot under the planet's
  panel); shots.json space_hud note "Fuel"; shots retaken: space_hud, damage, surface_walk, archive.
Files: scripts/proc_art.gd, scripts/terrain_tiles.gd, scripts/minoan_tiles.gd, scripts/planet_surface.gd,
scripts/health_gauge.gd, scripts/hud.gd, scripts/surface_props.gd, data/docs/game.md, data/docs/shots.json,
data/docs/shots/space_hud.jpg, damage.jpg, surface_walk.jpg, archive.jpg.

## 2026-11-20 - Fuel as the gauge's outer ring

Asked: "add another circle outside the shield circle for spaceships for fuel, remove the numbers and label".
Done: HealthGauge.fuel ([fuel, max, the jump's need]) adds a third ring outside the shield's (ships only): amber
liquid as high as the tank is full (the ring shader again: as thick as the shield's ring, 3 px outside it - FUEL_W
18 px), its rim red when there's less than a jump's fuel (Shipyard.FUEL_JUMP); the affliction icons go round it.
Its numbers in the rings' tooltip with the hull's and shields' ("Fuel 64 / 100", "not enough to jump"). The space
HUD's fuel row (FUEL label, bar, number) hidden, its updating code gone (hud.gd _update_fuel, fuel_bar, fuel_value).
Docs: game.md (the fuel ring); space_hud notes point at the hull and at the fuel ring; space_hud, damage, archive
retaken. Tests: all 299 pass.
Files: scripts/health_gauge.gd, scripts/hud.gd, data/docs/game.md, data/docs/shots.json, data/docs/shots/*.jpg.

## 2026-11-20 - Fix: asteroids never showed

Asked: "asteroid fail to render".
Found: every rock of a streamed system stayed at modulate alpha 0 and disabled. A piece of the system fades in when
it's made (main.gd _make_piece) - by a tween made on the piece itself; a rock made off screen is stopped by its own
VisibleOnScreenEnabler2D at once, which stopped its tween with it: the fade never ran, the rock never showed (40 of
40 in Knossos).
Done: the fade is the scene's tween (main's), not the piece's - it runs whatever the piece does. Checked in a window:
the rocks round Amnissos drawn. Test: test_play.test_system_streams_in checks every rock, station and planet ends
fully shown (with the old code: 27 faint - fails).
Files: scripts/main.gd, tests/test_play.gd.

## 2026-11-20 - One console: the event log and the loading console as tabs

Asked: "join both console the event and the asset loading console to one console, make tabs for each one use icons
to change between tabs".
Done: GameLog (event_log.gd) is the one console, bottom left: at its top two icon tabs (the event log's journal
icon, the loading console's reload icon - EditorIcons, their tooltips saying what each is), then the shown tab's
name ("EVENT LOG / LOADING   (L to hide)"). The shown tab framed and bright, the other dimmed; which one is shown
kept while the game runs (GameLog.tab, show_tab()). The loading console (LoadBar) is now the second tab's page -
its history with the scroll bar, the memory pool's line, the progress bar and the memory map - no panel of its own
above the log, no fold arrow (the tab does that); it keeps taking the notes while hidden. The loading tab's icon
has a thin line under it as long as the work under way is done, seen from either tab.
Docs: game.md (the console's two tabs, the progress under the icon; the fold arrow gone); space_hud's notes (one for
the tabs; the memory map's note gone) and caption; shots retaken: space_hud, salvage, archive.
Tests: all pass (test_play.test_landing_builds_in_background timed out once under the parallel run's load; passes alone).
Files: scripts/event_log.gd, data/docs/game.md, data/docs/shots.json, data/docs/shots/*.jpg.

## 2026-11-20 - Navigation reports: the nav beacon reports the system instead of lifting the fog; reports sold elsewhere

Asked: "nav beacon no longer removes fog and reveals all locations in solar system, instead gives you a stats panel
with list of all stations, solar bodies, gates, amount of enemies and allied npcs etc essentially a local report for
the system. This navigation reports can be sold in stations in other systems, the further the system the higher the
price".
Done:
- NavReports (new, scripts/nav_reports.gd): make(tree, sys) - the system as it is: its stations (and who holds
  them), planets and moons (their kind - ocean world, lava world... - moon of what, landable), jump gates (where to),
  ships alive - hostile ones by who they are (pirates, empires at war with you), friendly and neutral by empire, all
  by trade - monsters (EnemyTypes.MONSTERS), asteroids, unsalvaged wrecks, signals; summary(). The report is an item,
  "navrep:<system>" (kind "report"; Items.info / exists / display_name / draw_icon hooks, PlayerData.held_items),
  its description the summary; its icon a chart slate. price(sys, at) = 60 + 70 a jump between the systems (jumps():
  shortest way along the lanes) + 10 per station of its system; 0 in its own.
- NavReportPanel (new, scripts/nav_report_panel.gd): the report on screen - three columns (stations and gates;
  planets and moons, landable in green; hostile ships, friendly and neutral ships, by trade, monsters, the rest) and
  what the copy sells for; ✕ / Esc; menu text size.
- The beacon (main.gd chart_with_beacon): the scan makes the report, shows it, keeps it (Galaxy.reports, saved) and -
  once a visit (Galaxy.jumps counted on each jump, report_issued) - puts a copy in your hold; scanned again this
  visit: the report shown at once. Galaxy.chart_system no longer reveals the fog (explored_at no longer counts a
  scanned system as seen); the stations still become known (trade runs) and the bodies and stations go in the
  Encyclopedia. The beacon still turns green and animated once scanned.
- Stations' Sell tab: a report's price by distance ("160 dr · 1 jump from Phaistos"); in its own system its buttons
  off ("Worthless here: its own system"); never sold by "Sell all cargo".
- Fix on the way: the sell page's loop lost its card line in the edit (caught by the fog tests before anything else).
- Docs: game.md (the scanner line; a "Navigation reports" section); shot nav_beacon's caption; new shot nav_report
  (doc_shots.gd: scans the beacon) with notes; shots retaken (11).
- Tests: test_fog.test_nav_beacon_report (was ..._charts_the_system): the fog stays; the report lists every station,
  gate, the planets, the ships; shown on screen; one copy a visit, another after leaving and coming back; named for
  its system; worthless at home, more the further; kept in the save.
Numbers: 1 jump 170 dr, 2 jumps 240, 4 jumps 380 (Knossos: 4 stations).
Files: scripts/nav_reports.gd (new), scripts/nav_report_panel.gd (new), scripts/main.gd, scripts/galaxy.gd,
scripts/items.gd, scripts/player_data.gd, scripts/station_menu.gd, tests/test_fog.gd, tests/doc_shots.gd,
data/docs/game.md, data/docs/shots.json, data/docs/shots/*.jpg.

## 2026-11-20 - Probes moved as a group

Asked: "add ability to move the probes as a group".
Done (map_page.gd MapView, with the PROBES panel open):
- A gold group handle (a diamond with four arrows) above the topmost probe, in line with their middle (above, not in
  the middle: the launch pattern puts a probe there), shown with two probes or more: drag it and every probe moves
  with it, keeping the formation (lines from the handle to each while dragging).
- Shift + drag any probe: the whole group moves the same way. A plain drag still moves just that one.
- The wheel over the handle spreads the formation out (x1.25) or draws it in (x0.8) round its middle.
- Shift + wheel over a probe: every probe's reach a step up / down (ProbeScanner.step_all).
- The move cursor over the handle and over a probe with Shift held. The panel's help and the PROBES button's tooltip
  say how.
- Docs: game.md's probe scanner; the probes shot's notes (the handle; the old notes re-aimed) and caption.
- Tests: test_mining_industry.test_probes_move_as_a_group (mouse events on the map: Shift + drag, the handle clear of
  every probe and dragged, a plain drag moving one, the wheel spreading, Shift + wheel stepping every reach).
Files: scripts/pages/map_page.gd, tests/test_mining_industry.gd, data/docs/game.md, data/docs/shots.json,
data/docs/shots/probes.jpg.

## 2026-11-20 - Shields recharging and the hull mending burn fuel

Asked: "recharging the shield and auto repairing the hull costs fuel".
Done: your ship's shields recharging and its hull's self-repair (and Nanite Repair's) burn fuel as they come back:
Shipyard.FUEL_PER_SHIELD 0.02 a point (a full 100-point shield: 2 fuel), FUEL_PER_HULL 0.05 (100 hull: 5) - a jump
is 10. Ship._regen_fuel pays for what the tank can (a little fuel: that much back); out of fuel neither comes back
("Out of fuel: shields and hull can't recharge", once, in the log too). Station repairs, repair kits and the
automaton's shield on foot are unchanged; NPC ships don't use fuel.
Docs: game.md (shields and hull, fuel). Test: test_damage_feedback.test_regen_costs_fuel (10 shield points cost 0.2;
the hull's mending its share; none with an empty tank; a little fuel buys that much).
Files: scripts/ship.gd, scripts/shipyard.gd, tests/test_damage_feedback.gd, data/docs/game.md.
